session_items.Title: Welcome to Rocket.Chat Alumni Summit 2026!
session_items.Description: Opening remarks to welcome contributors, mentors, alumni, and community members joining the summit.
session_items.Speaker: Felipe Scuciatto / Gabriel Engel / Sing Li

session_items.Title: Building a Global Network through GSoC
session_items.Description: Yuriko shares how GSoC opened the door to international collaboration, mentorship, and long-term open-source work at Rocket.Chat.
session_items.Speaker: Yuriko Kikuchi

session_items.Title: From Open Source Contributor to Rocket.Chat: Lessons from My GSoC Journey
session_items.Description: Rohit shares how steady open-source contributions led to Google Summer of Code, a deeper focus on mobile testing, and eventually a role at Rocket.Chat.
session_items.Speaker: Rohit Bansal

session_items.Title: Success Stories and Lessons Learned from GSoC Alumni
session_items.Description: Vipin shares lessons from continuing in open source after GSoC, mentoring contributors, and building developer tools in the real world.
session_items.Speaker: Vipin Chaudhary

session_items.Title: Building a Global Network through GSoC
session_items.Description: Dhairyashil talks about how open-source work at Rocket.Chat helped him move from contributor to product engineer and expand his professional network.
session_items.Speaker: Dhairyashil Shinde

session_items.Title: Community Hangout
session_items.Description: An open slot for attendees and speakers to connect, ask questions, and continue the conversation around GSoC and open source.

session_items.Title: Building with (and against) AI: Lessons in Modern Open Source Workflow
session_items.Description: Abhinav reflects on modern open-source development, where AI can speed up delivery, create friction, and still reward careful engineering judgment.
session_items.Speaker: Abhinav Kumar

session_items.Title: Building a Global Network through GSoC
session_items.Description: Ahmed reflects on how GSoC and open source helped him connect with a broader technical community while growing as an engineer.
session_items.Speaker: Ahmed Nasser

session_items.Title: Closing Notes
session_items.Description: Closing remarks and thanks from the Rocket.Chat team.
session_items.Speaker: Felipe Scuciatto / Gabriel Engel / Sing Li
